name: Dragons
description: The Dragons were a youth street gang active in New York City, with documented origins in East Harlem around 1953. Part of the postwar generation of NYC neighborhood gangs, they reportedly expanded to multiple boroughs and by 1960 had divisions in every borough except Staten Island.
